More than a venue

More Than a Venue: An Experience

Your wedding at Ananda is not built around a fixed template. It is built around your vision.

Start with a ceremony set in a natural, open setting. Move into a relaxed cocktail hour surrounded by the property. End the night with a reception that feels personal, not prescribed.

Every part of the day flows together, without feeling rushed or restricted.

You stay in control of your vision, without starting from scratch.
